name: feral-special-s4-attempt-02b
prompt:
Produce ONE sparse PORTRAIT native RGBA sprite sheet1024x1536: exactly TWO COLUMNS×FOUR ROWS, EIGHT isolated full-body drawings. Use attached images ONLY for Feral's identity/anatomy/style, not their backgrounds. New articulated poses, never mirror or rig. Accurate Feral: lean sinewy ochre-spotted skin, black dreads, ivory bone skull mask and exposed red mandibles, dark segmented loincloth, asymmetrical bone hip ornaments, bronze bracers, wrapped ankles and clawed bare toes. No shoulder cannon.

Every invisible cell512×384. Body about180px tall, never larger than210px, with at least80px ALPHA ZERO space above and below. Whole drawing including gear/any neutral stand-in below380px wide and inside its own cell. Huge empty transparent gutters; no touching/cropped silhouettes. LEFT COLUMN: Feral faces RIGHT, front/right-side view. RIGHT COLUMN: independently drawn Feral faces LEFT, back/left-side view; asymmetric gear stays on the same anatomical limbs. Same stage on each row. Same fixed body scale everywhere.

BACKGROUND MUST BE ALPHA0 outside the exact figure/gear silhouettes: NO floor plane, no cast shadow, no aura, no ambient glow, no gradient, no fog, smoke or painted backdrop. Crisp narrow edges, no blur. No text, numbers, labels, borders or grid.

GEAR AND SCOPE: This is an explicitly original gameplay-derived mine-placement body study. One small flat bronze mechanical hunting device, not a canonical power. Shield folded left, wrist blades retracted, no launcher or spear.

ROW1: Neutral standing guard, empty hands, folded bracers; the single small device is still secured at the hip. This neutral reference is outside the clip and must show complete standing anatomy for a fixed body-height review.
ROW2: Feral straightens his knees and steps a little backward from the same device still on the ground, left hand lifting empty.
ROW3: He brings both empty hands back toward guard and looks down at the stationary device; tiny indicator is now red but no blast, no damage.
ROW4: Feral settles into a grounded guard, leaning away from the stationary armed device with both hands free; one device only.
CRITICAL SECOND PASS: Use reference1 for its generous empty transparent gutters and smaller figures. All drawings MUST occupy only the MIDDLE HALF of each cell height, like tiny miniature icons; leave top and bottom quarter empty, do not zoom to fill the cells. Use reference2 for THE EXACT SAME MINE: a tiny thin circular bronze OPENWORK RING with radial cutouts and a small center orange button, NOT a thick octagonal box, no armor plates or opaque cylinder. The one mine stays at the same relative front-foot ground position. Calibration row1 has the same thin ring at the hip. Row2 steps back from the ring and indicator is AMBER; row3 guard looks down at the very same ring and indicator is OFF (dark center, no emission); row4 settles into guard, indicator is RED. Every state shares identical ring construction/diameter. No wrist blades extended, no weapon. Native pixels outside figures AND the single ring are exactly alpha0.
